text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, understood! Understood! 
Please link the broadcasts across all 
stages now.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
Every venue is reporting immense success 
without a hitch. 
Part 2 is about to begin... which means,

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
it's time for the debut of 
"GIRLS' LEGEND U."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This song won't just be performed 
here on Stage A; 
it will be performed simultaneously on 
Stage B, Stage C... and all the others.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Every horsegirl will sing at the exact 
same moment, 
igniting the passion of all our fans 
together.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, our technical team pooled all their 
expertise 
into making this possible. We're going to 
give everyone an unforgettable time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
For the horsegirls, for the fans... 
—and for you as well!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want to dedicate this live to all those 
who have supported me along the way.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To everyone back home, of course. And to 
every single 
fan who has cheered me on!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I will show them all— 
just how strong I have grown!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Through spring, summer, autumn, and 
winter, 
yearning, longing...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this song is so intriguing, isn't 
it? 
Because in the end, it all leads back to 
running.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yet that's what makes it so true to us 
horsegirls. 
I really think the lyrics turned out 
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! 
Deep breath in... and out...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, everyone! 
Let's pour all our hearts and voices into 
this!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This live shall grant you power! 
Expand your possibilities, enhance your 
utility, and transcend 
even your limits!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, and that goes for you too, Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It can't end yet—it's far from over! 
Let's all sing together! 
"GIRLS' LEGEND U"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All that was left was for "GIRLS' LEGEND 
U" 
to resound across the stage—
